data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'azama, meaning 'to desire' or 'to be desired'. In Islamic history, Muazma is the name of a beloved companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Muazma carries the meaning “Desired, Lovely” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muazma usually hope their child will grow to embody desired, lovely and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Muazma belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desired, Lovely.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muazma total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: مُعَظْمَة
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم يدل على تعظيم وتكريم الشخص
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم مُعَظْمَة مشتق من العظمة، وهو يعني تعظيم وتكريم الشخص، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، منها قوله تعالى: "وليال عشر من رمضان"، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في العصور الإسلامية المبكرة لتسمية النساء اللواتي يتمتعن بالعزة والكرامة.

in_urdu.name: معظمی
